# Local execution in Remote Arc

Read SKILL.md and the included resources. Materialize only the files needed in an authorized local project folder, then run the renderer on the connected computer. Keep editable source and seeds with PNG/PDF exports. Inspect the actual rendered image before delivery. No model download or paid image API is required for code graphics. If a request needs photographic synthesis, use the separate Image Studio/ComfyUI workflow and check the actual backend and model availability.

For offline artifacts, embed or locally serve pinned p5.js and fonts instead of depending on a CDN at viewing time. The upstream viewer remains the starting point. Local-only rendering does not imply AI request text bypasses the selected model service.
